statusRule: ONE rule for every row. A row describes the ROUTE the contract proposes: the shipped mapper (phase2/sketch-map.mjs) plus the guard in contract/sketch-constraints-r5 (guard.mjs: preflight; an independent solve of the rows with continuation, rule residuals, collapsed shapes, under-constrained-and-moved refusal, branch check against the drawn start, nearest mirror image; the EXPECTED solid computed without a kernel (expect.mjs); SolidCraft started from the independent solution with explicit even-odd profile picks and construction arcs marked; the built solid compared with the expectation; plain one-sentence refusals). EVERY measurement behind a supported / refused / wrong status was run on the SUPPLIED referee pkg (SOLIDCRAFT_REFEREE_PKG only): no row rests on a number that needs the lost wrapper2 @sketch dump. wrong = at least one measured case (stored geometry, a 3.5% or 15% hand-drawn rough start, a 40% or 80% stress start, a permuted row order, a param drag, a jittered tangent chain) in which the route BUILDS a solid that disagrees with the oracle (closed form, and live brep-rs / OCCT / FreeCAD where they can referee it) and shows no refusal. refused = the feature as written is refused with a plain sentence in every case measured (by design or because SolidCraft cannot hold it). supported = every measured case either builds a solid that matches the oracle within tolerance (planar 1e-9 relative on volume and bbox; curved 3e-4 because truck volumes are tessellation-derived) or is refused with a plain sentence; the stored geometry builds, and the refusal counts at every amplitude are in the evidence. Every refusal sentence must be exactly ONE sentence (audit.mjs counts them) and name no solver internals or row numbers; a driving:false reference is never a request (it is measured, not enforced); a redundant but consistent row is built while a real conflict is refused. unsupported = could not be measured on this rig (the reason is in the row). Rows that name "shipped ... without the guard" describe the code as it stands today and carry the count of silent wrong builds it produces; they are wrong by the same rule.
rig: ROUND 6: every measurement in this file was re-run live on the supplied pkg under a 1500M cgroup cap, one job at a time, in chunks killed at 900 s (sh run-all.sh; floating-slot.mjs and scale.mjs are new); the guarded route is the round-5 guard (independent solve, kernel-free expected solid) with the round-6 curved-volume bar. The wrapper2 pkg (@sketch dump) the round-3/4 critic could not replay is NOT used: round 5 removed the dependency. SolidCraft fe3717f wasm, the SUPPLIED pre-built referee pkg (SOLIDCRAFT_REFEREE_PKG = dir holding solidcraft_referee.js, wasm-bindgen --target nodejs of wrapper/, 23 MB wasm). NOTHING ELSE IS NEEDED: round 3 depended on the phase2/wrapper2 pkg that returns the @sketch dump (solved points, SolveReport, profile list); that pkg was lost in a reboot and is not rebuilt (the task forbids it). Round 5 therefore (a) recovers per-command results by running the command list and, when a command is refused, dropping it and running again (lib.mjs scRaw), (b) takes the SOLVED sketch from an independent least-squares solve of the same rows with continuation (solve5.mjs, a copy of the sketch-geometry solver; Jacobian-rank dof), (c) computes the EXPECTED solid from that solution without any kernel (expect.mjs: exact loop areas, centroids and boxes with arcs, even-odd regions, crossing / touching refusals), (d) hands SolidCraft the independent solution as its starting geometry and the even-odd profile picks, and (e) refuses any build whose volume, bbox, centre of mass, body count or (straight-line outlines) face count differs from the expectation. Every guard row was re-run on this rig: run-all.sh needs only SOLIDCRAFT_REFEREE_PKG. Oracles: closed form (arithmetic next to each case, plus every mirror image that still satisfies the rules: oracle.mjs), live brep-rs wasm archive/brep-rs/pkg, live OCCT replicad-opencascadejs, saved FreeCAD refs docs/replica/freecad/gauntlet/variants/refs. brep-rs and OCCT cannot referee rows that use the built-in axes or construction geometry, and brep-rs puts a circle that was drawn below a line tangent ABOVE it, so brep-rs 'WRONG' counts in the sweeps are brep-rs disagreeing with the drawn side, not evidence against SolidCraft.
howToRun: cd <repo>; export SOLIDCRAFT_REFEREE_PKG=<pkg dir with solidcraft_referee.js>; sh docs/spikes/solidcraft-referee/contract/sketch-constraints-r5/run-all.sh (sweeps, perm-test, profiles-test, stored-run, param-grid, legacy-run, accuracy, probes, placement, redundant, references, axes, arcs-fuzz, param-drags, exp-arcs, extras, jitter, underconstrained, planar-bar, audit: one job at a time under systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=16G -p MemorySwapMax=0), then bun docs/spikes/solidcraft-referee/contract/sketch-constraints-r5/build-rows.mjs. No shadow root: the scripts find the repo from their own location and read archive/brep-rs/pkg directly.

round6Fixes.critic: The 3e-4 curved volume bar fails at small sketch scale and the guard does not check
round6Fixes.done: guard.mjs: a curved build is accepted only within 3e-4 of the exact area x height (was 2e-3); a small curved sketch failing only on that is refused with its own sentence. scale.mjs: 6 curved fixtures x scales 1e-3 .. 1e3 through the guard.

round6Fixes.critic: The guarded route was never replayed live
round6Fixes.done: the whole round-5/6 chain (sh run-all.sh, 21 jobs) re-run on the live pkg with exit 0 for every job; the sweeps twice (identical guarded totals); no wrapper2 pkg needed.

floating-slot.mjs: the unguarded route builds wrong on 15 % starts, the guard refuses every start (underconstrained) and builds none wrong. The 3.5 % start of the critic DOES reproduce the wrong build unguarded (3634.8, bbox y from -11.48) and the guard refuses it; an earlier note here that it did not reproduce was false (floating-slot.mjs used a different geomBox) and is withdrawn.

round6Fixes.critic: The sweep oracle scores volume and bbox only, from the guard's own solver
round6Fixes.done: oracle.mjs: centre of mass and face count are compared against the exact solid of each image (kernel-free arithmetic); images are filtered by the independent rule checker.

round6Fixes.critic: Evidence paths abbreviated with .../ and out/sentences.json
round6Fixes.done: every cited command and path is written in full (out/sentences.jsonl)
BRANCH, the angle sentence, and two others reworded without the word solver

round3Fixes.critic: The guarded route builds a constrained sketch on an offset plane or a frame at offset 0 (silent wrong solid)
round3Fixes.done: guardedSketch reads sk.plane / sk.offset / sk.frame and hands them to the mapper; a placement preflight refuses unknown planes and malformed frames; a placement stage after the extrude compares the solid (centre of mass along the normal, in-plane position, world bbox) with the frame and refuses a mismatch. placement.mjs: 83 constrained sketches (3 shapes x 15 placements x stored/rough) all built at the right place against live brep-rs and OCCT; the round-2 route is kept as a control (71 of 71 placed sketches built at offset 0 with no refusal; the placement stage refuses all 71)

round3Fixes.critic: Refusal sentences are not single sentences (38 of 40 permuted-run sentences were two)
round3Fixes.done: CONFLICT and BRANCH rewritten as one sentence, only the first mapper refusal is shown, sentenceCount() lint (refs.mjs) over every final refusal of every run script (ladderSketch logs them to $SENTENCE_LOG; audit.mjs); the wording row now fails on a sentence count other than one

round3Fixes.critic: Redundant but consistent dimensions are refused with a false "they conflict" reason, and slot-extra-radius is order dependent (9 of 16 refused, 7 built)
round3Fixes.done: the guard sets aside a row SolidCraft refuses as already determined, solves the rest, and builds only if the solved sketch meets the set-aside row; otherwise refuses with the conflict sentence. redundant.mjs measures all nine sk-conflict / slot fixtures from docs/replica (FreeCAD refs: redundant and conflicting lists, Invalid sketches with no bbox) stored, 12 rough starts and 16 shuffled row orders each

round3Fixes.critic: Arc rows off the circle refused far more widely than the lock-on-c row says
round3Fixes.done: the preflight is narrowed to an arc whose centre a lock row pins; every other off-circle arc is solved and checked after the solve. exp-arcs.mjs and arcs-fuzz.mjs (hand-typed slots and ovals, ends pushed off the circle by 1e-5 to 2 mm, 280 rough starts per arm) compare with live brep-rs and the closed form; phase2 own-slot-dims-from-points (0.29 mm off) now builds

round3Fixes.critic: driving:false reference: spurious refusal of a reference on the other side of the drawing, wrong value accepted silently
round3Fixes.done: reference rows are never sent to SolidCraft (they add no equation; brep-rs session.rs reference_values says their stored number is stale by design); the route builds what the other rows fix and returns the measured value of every reference (result.references: stored, measured, stale), checked against brep-rs diagnose().references and the closed form; a reference on a non-dimension is refused in one sentence like brep-rs

round3Fixes.critic: Built-in axes in angle, equal and tangent rows, and the other rule kinds, have no row
round3Fixes.done: axes.mjs: 20 rule kind x slot x axis combinations; a tangent to an axis is now refused up front because the independent rule checker cannot read it (it used to throw inside the guard); a guard that throws is a refusal, never a build

round3Fixes.critic: Slider-style param drags cross branches and the single refused row does not enumerate the gaps
round3Fixes.done: param-drags.mjs: eight families (rectangle width, hole diameter, hole centre across the edge, external and internal tangent radius, slot radius, triangle angle in 5 degree steps, signed distanceX across 0, height to 0) as slider steps from the last built geometry and as jumps from the stored one, scored RIGHT / REFUSED-VALID (capability gap) / REFUSED-INVALID / WRONG against closed forms, with live brep-rs on the jumps; one row per family for each outcome class

round3Fixes.critic: Hole drags that make the outline cross itself were refused as a branch
round3Fixes.done: a crossing or self-crossing outline has its own sentence (CROSSING) instead of the branch sentence

round2Fixes.critic: No check after the solve confirms SolidCraft stayed on the drawn branch
round2Fixes.done: guard.mjs now runs five post-solve checks (SolveReport status, independent signed rule residuals, branch.mjs loop / corner / arc / tangent / symmetric / angle-quadrant / cusp features, images.mjs nearest mirror image, evenOddProfiles); every sweep row reports shipped-vs-guarded counts on the same seeds

round2Fixes.critic: Result depends on rule row order
round2Fixes.done: ladder of canonical row orders (JGTD*, GJTD*, GTDJ*, as written), first rung that passes every check wins; perm-test.mjs measures the four named orders and 12 random permutations x 6 starts x 8 fixtures
one STATUS_RULE, statuses derived by deriveStatus() from the measurements; rows that describe the shipped code without the guard are separate rows and are wrong by the same rule
plainMapper / plainSc / preflight sentences name rows of sk.rules() and geometry numbers only; probes.mjs audits every sentence collected from every run against a forbidden-token pattern

round2Fixes.critic: Legacy rows judged at 1e-5 and nothing refuses over-constrained legacy rules
round2Fixes.done: judged at 1e-9; route B (legacy rules as soup rows solved by SolidCraft) meets it, the shipped route A does not (own wrong row); the settle in runScript drops conflicting rules silently (own wrong row, upstream); unsettled fights are refused by an independent residual check

round2Fixes.critic: Endpoint tangency accuracy not observable, resting on a prior measurement
round2Fixes.done: accuracy.mjs reads SolidCraft's solved points from the @sketch dump: joint perpendicularity, gap, end-radius mismatch, volume, max_residual over stored + 30 rough starts per fixture

round2Fixes.critic: lock supported but a separate wrong row for arcs off the circle
round2Fixes.done: preflight refuses any arc whose ends are not on its circle, so lock-on-c cannot pin a three-point circumcentre
reproduced (profiles-test.mjs), shipped selector row is wrong, evenOddProfiles (winding number) is the contract selector
probes.mjs: both slots x four row orders x three amplitudes x 24 starts, shipped vs guarded, with SolidCraft's own error texts counted

round2Fixes.critic: Param drag across a branch not measured
round2Fixes.done: param-grid.mjs: 13 x 7 angle grid and 6 x 6 signed-distance grid; refused with a sentence, never wrong

round2Fixes.critic: Origin reference without an end: mapper accepts, brep-rs refuses
round2Fixes.done: preflight refuses it with brep-rs's meaning in plain words; the repro shows both engines

rows.feature: sweep oracle: a guarded build counts as right only if volume, bbox, CENTRE OF MASS and (straight-line outlines) FACE COUNT agree with an exact image of the rules
rows.evidence: cmd: SOLIDCRAFT_REFEREE_PKG=<pkg> systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=1500M -p MemorySwapMax=0 bun docs/spikes/solidcraft-referee/contract/sketch-constraints-r5/run-sweeps.mjs (--fracs=0.8,0.4,0.15,0.035, via run-all.sh) || round 4/5 critic: the sweeps scored a build right on volume and bbox only, so a different outline with the same area and bbox was MATCH. oracle.mjs classifyImg now also requires, against each candidate image, the centre of mass (first moment, exact arithmetic from the loops of the image: expect.mjs, no kernel) within 1e-6 of the sketch size (planar) / 1e-3 (curved), and the face count for straight-line outlines; same volume and bbox with another centre of mass or face count is class SHAPE and counts as BUILT-WRONG. Tolerances were fixed before the run. Result: 2571 guarded builds carry a centre-of-mass check (of 2997 built; the rest are cases scored by closed form only: a sketch with no solved image), largest centre-of-mass difference 3.6e-6 of the sketch size, no case turned into SHAPE (guarded totals identical to the round-5 replay). The images are the mirror images of the guard's solver result that PASS the independent rule checker phase2/rule-check.mjs, so an image is a valid solution of the rules whoever found it; a branch the guard mis-solves is not an image unless it satisfies every rule. Limits that stay: brep-rs refuses circle-circle, symmetric trapezoid and symmetric-about-construction-line, so those sweep cells have the closed form, the exact image (volume, bbox, centre of mass) and the guard's own comparison, but no second kernel.
